newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech January real industrial sales -0.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech January real industrial sales -0.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real industrial sales in January eased 0.2 percent, year-on-year, while nominal industrial wages rose 14.4 percent, year-on-year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
Comparative figures for industrial sales were not immediately available as it is the first time the CSU has published the indicator. Nominal industrial wages rose 21.1 percent in December.
